data.name: Sharwateek
data.gender_notes: Sharwateek is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is blessed with the grace of the gods, Sharwateek is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharva' meaning God and 'teek' meaning victory or protection. The name Sharwateek carries the meaning “Blessed with God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharwateek usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies being blessed by the divine and the attainment of victory and protection through the grace of the gods.
data.etymology: Sharwateek belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwateek total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
